notes.title: Version 0.3.50 - It's Time
notes.content:
It's time for the Holidays! Spread Company cheer to new winter stations! 

- Added new Arctic surface biome with 5 new maps
- Added Arctic Checkpoint
- Added Blizzard weather event
- Entities are now extra festive
- Arctic biome spawn chance will be lowered after the season ends
- Added Wiki button to main menu
- Bug fixes!

Thank you all for being such a supporting community!

notes.title: Version 0.3.31 - Controller Support
notes.content:
You ask I deliver! All actions are now bound to controller inputs. You still have to type in terminal commands, but all normal gameplay can now be enjoyed on any gamepad of your choosing. One thing to note is controller input bindings currently cannot be changed.

 - Controller support
 - Dynamic input switching
 - Added Quick Delivery upgrade
 - Spaces in upgrade names have been replaced with underscores
 - Various bug fixes

I am planning to have the next big update out in early December, so keep an eye out!

notes.title: Version 0.3.25 - Say Cheese
notes.content:
The largest update since launch! Added the Snatcher and Observer to keep things interesting (or terrifying). You can also try out the new bodycam equipment. The shopkeeper might be rocking a new hat, and there are new scrap items to find!


- Added Snatcher entity
- Added Observer entity
- Added 4 new scrap items
- Added new Facility tiles
- Shopkeeper now has a chance to wear a random hat
- Added bodycam equipment
- Helmet radios are now usable while viewing minimap and employee screens
- Added helmet radio enable/disable key
- Added VIEW_BODYCAM command
- Tweaked scrap market values
- Updated Stalker log entry to better reflect its new behavior
- Added Lorekeeper achievement
- Various bug fixes


Thank you all for playing! I hope to have another big update in by the end of the month.
